ordinary_collector.authority: One real public QMP Apply/capture collector shared with camera; reuses memory collector read-only GDMA and provenance machinery, no synthetic pixels or ACKs.
ordinary_collector.source_gate: Fresh native ext4 immutable fixture inventory, exact pinned SDK/submodules, unmodified official camera and local public esp_jpeg1.3.1 Component Manager resolution, actual compiler command sources, app ELF digest and exact merged-image inputs.
ordinary_collector.scope: 16 ordinary panel profiles per SDK, plus distinct quad40 external double/bounce and genuine physical graph negatives; raw immutable captures and host stop/resume retained.
ordinary_collector.clock_contract: Established UART/RMT deterministic launch: -accel tcg,thread=single -icount shift=0,align=off,sleep=off, with normal machine CPU count retained. Functional virtual timing for exact physical model edges, not CPU cycle accuracy or hardware reference metrology; actual command and host stop/resume boundaries are preserved.
ordinary_collector.sdk6_transport: Explicit equal in/out_color_format; GRAY8 supplies raw eight-bit transport for unchanged RGB332 payload (no conversion); RGB565/RGB888 match 16/24-bit payloads. SDK5 retains bits_per_pixel.
ordinary_collector.camera_dependency: One approved official esp32-camera v2.1.8 commit b0556a78e13d42974aae19116f8a1e14c29b0f4d is required byte-exact on BOTH pinned SDKs. Earlier v2.1.3 new/legacy SCCB compile failures and successful SDK5 images remain historical diagnostics only, never new-pin build/runtime proof. No vendor/SDK patch, header alias or silent mode omission.
ordinary_collector.qualification: Authored collection contract only; acceptance requires each actual case result and independent byte/timing/ownership oracle. No physical/reference/metrology claim.

official reset/sleep-exit/MADCTL/COLMOD/RAMCTRL init sequence, inclusive CASET/RASET endpoints, RGB565 and byte-per-component RGB666

Public bits_per_pixel override, physical active wire cycles=h_res*bpp/data_width, actual GDMA EOF/bounce/VSYNC callbacks and separate S3 restart link; no old-buffer overwrite solely from an EOF callback.

Explicit public in/out_color_format controls buffer depth; equal formats disable conversion. GRAY8 is unchanged eight-bit transport, RGB565/RGB888 retain16/24-bit payloads and all declared physical wire-cycle timing. S3 AHB GDMA uses actual EOF handler, not the AXI-only link-switch callback.
RGB timing: HSYNC pulse, horizontal back porch, active width, horizontal front porch; VSYNC pulse, vertical back porch, active height, vertical front porch; explicit clock/sync/DE polarities

st7789-i80.power: Explicit rails, generic registered endpoint power epoch, 2.7..3.6 V
formats: COLMOD MCU field5 (0x55/0x65) RGB565: 8-bit two byte samples or 16-bit one word sample
COLMOD MCU field6 (0x56/0x66) RGB666: 8-bit three byte samples
st7789-i80.scope: Required digital memory, sleep/display, color order, byte order, address and reset commands are modeled. SWRESET and RESX preserve frame RAM exactly; only a new physical power epoch initializes the bounded digital canvas to black (silicon power-on RAM is unspecified, not claimed black). C2h VDVVRHEN consumes its documented two parameters. Listed analog/gamma initialization commands consume exact parameter counts only; no analog transfer curve claim. Inversion and refresh-order flags are observable state; RGB888 capture is RAM content, not simulated optical output. No reads/RD terminal, analog reset-pulse rejection, minimum reset/sleep delay, or analog LCD response emulation. Unsupported formats/commands are explicit errors. Configured smaller canvas is a bounded digital profile, not a new ST7789 silicon geometry.

required.pclk_active_high: boolean; sample rising when true, falling when false

rgb-panel.power: Explicit rails, generic registered endpoint power epoch, 2.7..3.6 V
formats: bus8 or bus16/pixel16 declared RGB565-LE byte stream
bus8 or bus16/pixel24 declared RGB888 R,G,B byte stream; width*bpp divisible by bus_width
rgb-panel.scope: Generic parallel digital sink, not an identified panel chip. Required bits_per_pixel is independent of bus_width; per-row active wire cycles equal width*bits_per_pixel/bus_width. RGB565-LE and RGB888 R,G,B are explicit functional stream profiles proven only when actual firmware buffers and controller bit/byte-order registers produce those wires, not universal panel color order. All timing derives from resolved PCLK/HSYNC/VSYNC/DE. observed_width counts logical completed pixels; observed_wire_width counts actual DE-active wire cycles. Malformed/unknown pixel samples remain zero at affected positions and valid=false; no guest framebuffer injection.

capture_contract.input: Only electrical solved-frame subscription, generic registered endpoints and actual role terminal samples. No GPIO-injected data, controller-frame calls, guest memory access or host path configuration.
capture_contract.capture-request-json: Exactly {componentId:string,offset:uint,count:integer 1..64}; offset is absolute zero-based sequence, must be retained or equal captures. Successful setter freezes selected records; failed setter preserves prior selection.
capture_contract.framebuffer-request-json: Exactly {componentId:string,sequence:uint,offset:uint,count:integer 1..65536}; sequence must be latest completed capture or previously frozen same-component sequence. First request freezes entire frame; later windows of same sequence do not replace snapshot. Offset 0..total_bytes. Failed setter preserves prior selection.
capture_contract.framebuffer-json: record plus {version:1,kind:lcd-panel-framebuffer,component_id,config_identity,format:rgb888,hex:lowercase hex bytes,width,height,offset,count,total_bytes}. All windows for selected sequence remain immutable. Component removal or immutable identity change invalidates requests.
capture_contract.bytes: RGB888 row-major full configured canvas, no padding; SHA256 covers exactly width*height*3 bytes. RGB565 expands by bit replication. RGB332 expands 3-bit components by (c<<5)|(c<<2)|(c>>1), blue by c*85. RGB666 expands high six byte bits by (byte&0xfc)|(byte>>6).
capture_contract.st_memory_order: CASET/RASET inclusive x/y coordinates advance x first then y and wrap window. MADCTL MV swaps x/y before canvas mapping, MX reflects canvas x, MY reflects canvas y, BGR swaps R/B. RAMWR resets cursor; RAMWRC keeps cursor. Sleep/display affect visible, not RAM writes. Captures at each completed address-window wrap include entire canvas, not only the window.
capture_contract.timing: All ns values are actual virtual solved-frame times. RGB period minima/maxima are successive sampled active PCLK intervals. Observed horizontal porch values describe last active row; invalid line variations increment rgb_timing. Vertical porches derive first/last active sampled lines. ST timing fields are zero because captures are memory-write completions rather than scanout emulation.
capture_contract.bounds: 32 panels maximum, 64 metadata records per panel, two width*height*3 byte buffers per panel; one service-wide explicit-query RGB888 snapshot plus one 64-record metadata snapshot. No per-edge heap allocation or file I/O. Ring eviction increments evicted_count and first_retained_sequence and never affects guest execution.
capture_contract.append_archive: Host runner saves immutable capture-json records and contiguous framebuffer-json windows, decodes hex into binary RGB888, checks sequence/config identity and SHA256, then appends evidence outside the native service. Host polling/render skips never rewrite retained records; metadata eviction is explicit. No unlimited retention claim without host archival.

review_vectors: Registered powered 8-bit ST7789 normal IDF init, 64x48 RGB565 CASET/RASET/RAMWR; compare RGB888 hash to independent byte-pair decoder
16-bit ST7789 RGB565 one word per rising WR, low-byte command/parameter order; 8-bit RGB666; little-endian RGB565 RAMCTRL
MADCTL MX/MY/MV/BGR with asymmetric corner pattern; partial window plus wrap and RAMWRC
Disconnected/unknown WR, DC, RESET, data terminal or power rail: meaningful counters, no valid fabricated frame; wrong CS yields no command acceptance
Wrong DC, wrong bus wiring/order, odd payload, unsupported COLMOD, invalid/repairable address windows; count-preserving reset and generic power epoch transition
RGB16 64x48 HS2/HBP4/HFP4 VS2/VBP2/VFP2, all polarities, sample timing/frame count/cadence and SHA256
RGB porch mismatch, interrupted PCLK, unknown DE/HSYNC/VSYNC/data, short/long active row: invalid captures, measured dimensions and timing errors
More than64 captures: explicit eviction and absolute sequence rejection, no pause; frozen query windows unchanged while new scanouts complete
Apply rejection of unknown fields/fractional/wrong-type/out-of-range params; immutable identity and no-op Apply preservation; removal invalidates snapshots
